name: automattic/wp-super-cache-integration-tools
description: Isolated PHPUnit toolchain for the WordPress integration test tier. WordPress's WP_UnitTestCase is not compatible with PHPUnit 10+, while the smoke tier (the root composer.json) runs modern PHPUnit. Keeping the WP-compatible PHPUnit 9 toolchain here avoids a version clash in the root vendor directory. Used only by `make test-integration`; not installed in CI.
